text_block_list.text:
On race day. While waiting by the side of 
the track...

A serious-faced Super Creek and an Oguri 
Cap who appeared no different than usual 
were waiting for the race.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...Oguri-chan.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oguri-chan?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oguri-chan!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Are you alright, dear~? Your face looks a 
bit stiffer than usual...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder why. Ever since I heard 
everyone from my hometown was coming to 
watch... my body has felt stiff.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Nerves, perhaps? Would you like a piece of 
candy, dear~?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Thank you... I'll take it.

After receiving the candy from Super 
Creek, Oguri Cap appeared much calmer than 
she had moments before.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hey, even at a time like this... why are 
you able to worry about others?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Eh?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you about to run too? Shouldn't you 
be spending time on yourself?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, you asked me a similar question 
before, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Since then, I tried thinking about it in 
my own way. Why I always want to look 
after the other girls.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't find an answer for the longest 
time, but... I think I finally understand 
just a little now.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I want to run in races where everyone can 
give it their all.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
For example, dear... Oguri-chan, can you 
give it your all when you're super 
nervous?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: That... might be difficult.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Right? Being unable to give it your all is 
terribly frustrating, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
That's why I dote on everyone in all sorts 
of ways, so they can run with all their 
might.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I see... You really are... kind.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, not really, dear. Maybe I just 
want to run against everyone when they're 
at their best♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Understood. Then... all I have to 
do is run with everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'd be so happy if you did~♪ Let's 
compete with all our might out there.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'm going to go hand out candy 
to the other girls too, okay?

After that, Super Creek went around 
handing out candy to the other girls as 
well.
